blocks.text: Federated partners are guest and host partner admins that have received approval by two business partners for Business-to-Business (B2B) Federation. Federated partners have established a trust between two business partners (i.e., the host partner and guest partner) and have completed the Zero Trust Partner Federation process to set up a Federation. For a complete list of ranges and limits per feature, see Ranges & Limitations.
Federated partners provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: View a summary of all trusted partners and their statuses.
Manage the connectivity with your guest partners.

blocks.text: On the Federated Partners page (Private Access > B2B Exchange > Federation > Federated Partners), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Click the Filter icon to display or hide the filters.
Filter the information that appears in the table. By default, no filters are applied. Click Clear to clear the applied filters. To learn more, see Using Tables.
View a list of all federated partners that are configured for your organization. For each federated partner, you can see:
Partner: The name of the federated partner.
Federated On: The date that the trust between two business partners was established.
Status: The status of the federated partner (i.e., Active, Pause, or Terminate). Click the drop-down menu to view a list of statuses, or to pause or terminate the status of the federated partner.
Modify the columns displayed in the table.
View the federated applications for the federated partner. You can federate applications to make them eligible to share with host partners.
Display more rows or a different page of the table.
Go to the Pending Requests page to manage both incoming and outgoing Federation requests.
